description: This file defines a custom exception class `DuplicateClientIdentifierException` which extends an abstract exception class. The exception is used to signal duplicate client identifiers in the application, providing multiple constructors for different duplication scenarios and accessor methods for its data members.

classes.name: DuplicateClientIdentifierException
classes.description: A RuntimeException subclass used to indicate that a client identifier of a specific type is already present within the system. It includes data about the duplication, such as document type ID, identifier key, and identifier type.

methods.name: DuplicateClientIdentifierException
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with an identifier type, indicating a duplicate of that type.

methods.name: DuplicateClientIdentifierException
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with document type ID, identifier type, and identifier key, for detailed duplication context.

methods.name: DuplicateClientIdentifierException
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with client name, office name, identifier type, and identifier key—used for more descriptive exception messages.

methods.name: getDocumentTypeId
methods.description: Returns the document type ID associated with the duplicate identifier, if available.

methods.name: getIdentifierKey
methods.description: Returns the identifier key associated with the duplicate identifier.

methods.name: getIdentifierType
methods.description: Returns the type of the duplicate identifier.
